d: We are currently seeking passionate and dynamic Maintenance professionals who pride themselves on their ability to deliver extraordinary levels of customer service and provide creative solutions to our guests.
As an A/C Technician you are responsible to install, service and repair temperature and air quality control systems.
q: You should ideally have a diploma in maintenance of refrigeration systems or in building services engineering with previous experience in the same role and a proven knowledge in the operation and maintenance of the equipment. A good command of English and the ability to find fault and rectify subsystems are essential.
The ideal candidate will be self-motivated with a hands-on and flexible approach and be able to adapt to unpredictable events.
You are proactive and reliable and will thrive working in a busy environment and stay calm under pressure, have strong attention to detail and should possess the following competencies
r: li
Repair, maintain and provide technical attention to all electrical and mechanical refrigeration systems of the hotel freezer, fridges, ice makers, fan coil units, chiller, etc.
li
Maintain preventively all air conditioning and refrigeration systems within the hotel
li
Check on performance of refrigeration systems and components
li
Verify all door closing systems on walk in coolers freezer (door gaskets latches)
li
Check and maintain all defrosting systems and automation of ice makers
li
Work on maintenance requests from all departments
li
Ensure routine cleaning of fan coil units and air handling unit filters
li
Check on performance of air conditioning and chill water systems
li
Cooperate with all engineering colleagues in detention of failures of air condition and refrigeration system and function setup
li
Strict control on venting of CFC's to atmosphere
li
Overhauling of air condition refrigeration equipment and systems
li
Check all refrigeration and oil levels and control of major repairs
li
Cooperate and inform Engineering Storekeeper on purchase of parts
li
Carry out all works as per the country technical regulations and safety standards

d: We are seeking a motivated Application Support Specialist to join our IT team. The role focuses on supporting business applications to ensure high availability, performance, and fit-for-purpose functionality. The successful candidate will provide technical support, troubleshoot and diagnose incidents and bugs, manage knowledge artifacts, and collaborate with development and business teams to drive continuous improvement.
q: Reasonable Financial systems functional and technical background is a necessary requirement.
Proficiency with relational databases, particularly Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle; strong SQL query and performance-tuning skills.
Experience with debugging tools, application logs, profilers and diagnostic toolsets used to investigate production issues.
Solid knowledge of operating systems and server platforms: Microsoft Windows Server.
Familiarity with service management and ticketing tools such as JIRA, ServiceNow, or equivalent.
Experience with monitoring, alerting and logging platforms (Zabbix, Splunk or similar).
User satisfaction scores and feedback from business stakeholders.
System availability, uptime and incident recurrence rates.
Completeness and currency of knowledge base and runbooks.
Number and impact of automation improvements implemented to reduce manual tasks.
2–3 years of experience in application support, technical support or related IT roles supporting business-critical applications.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience supporting CRM and financial systems is strongly preferred.
Relevant certifications are a plus (e.g., Microsoft, Oracle, ITIL Foundation).
r: li
Handle all levels of support requests through the Service Desk ticketing system (e.g., JIRA, ServiceNow or similar).
li
Anticipate, diagnose, and resolve application-related problems and incidents in a timely manner.
li
Research, reproduce and diagnose software bugs; provide clear, actionable bug reports and work with development teams on fixes.
li
Provide feedback to development groups on longer-term application requirements, enhancements and technical debt.
li
Help set and maintain standards for application testing, documentation, release and rollout processes.
li
Identify support runbooks and repeatable tasks that can be automated to reduce manual interventions and improve MTTR.
li
Coordinate with internal departments and end users to ensure adequate training on system functions and new features.
li
Manage and maintain the business applications knowledge base; ensure it is current, searchable and accessible to relevant users and teams.
li
Basic scripting or automation experience (e.g., PowerShell, Python) to support runbook automation and operational tasks.
